class.name: AuthResult
class.brief_description: The verdict [method NetwAuthFlow.verify] answers a joining peer's credentials with.

method.name: accept
method.description: Returns an accepting verdict seating the peer under [param identity], with no rejection reason.

method.name: reject
method.description: Returns a refusing verdict carrying [param reason] back to the peer, with no identity.

members.member: Whether the peer is admitted. This is the only field the session reads to decide, so [member identity] and [member rejection_reason] describe a verdict rather than reaching one.
The identity an accepted peer is seated under, and [code]null[/code] on a refusal.
What the refused peer is told, and the empty string on an acceptance.
